title: —Pogue mahone! Acushla machree! It’s destroyed we are from this day! It’s destroyed we are surely!
html_source: Corrupt Gaelic meaning “Kiss my backside, my sweetheart”. Though Mulligan is generally presented by Joyce/Stephen as an disagreeable character, this reader at least has a certain sympathy with him at this point.
